title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Fifty thousand Pesos to Be Expended Under the Direction of the President of the Philippines for the Purpose of Identifying and Appropriately Marking the Historic Antiquities in the Philippines, or Preserving, or Acquiring the Same.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of fifty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, to be expended, under
the direction of the President of the Philippines, and through such agency, entity or committee as he may
create or designate, for defraying the necessary expenses in connection with the work of identifying,
designating, and appropriately marking the historic antiquities abounding in the Philippines, so that the
present and future generations may be impressed with the significance and value of the said antiquities. The
said fund shall also be available for preserving or repairing important antiquities owned by the Government of
the Philippines or any of its political subdivisions, and for the acquisition, by purchase or otherwise, of the
antiquities owned by private persons. All markers to be utilized as herein provided shall be uniform in form
and workmanship and the wordings that shall appear thereon shall in every case be submitted to the President
of the Philippines for approval prior to the casting of each marker. Any unexpended balance of the amount
hereby appropriated on December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven, shall revert to the general
funds of the Philippine Treasury.

In the prosecution of its work, the agency, entity or committee created or designated by the
President is hereby empowered to secure the cooperation of all public officials and citizens, wherever
possible, and such officials shall furnish to the agency, entity or committee, as the case may be, on its request,
copies of all records, papers, and information in their possession, relating to any subject under its
consideration, free of charge.

The necessary fund to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included yearly in the General
Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 12, 1936.
